_comment: oflm bench-embed <tag> -i utilities/bench-configs/bench-embed-32.json -- a shorter sweep than the default 128. max_batch picks the LARGEST stage and every smaller power of two runs after it, hardest first, so this gives 6 stages (32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1) rather than 8. Keys read: max_batch, iterations, task, texts. Omit texts to use the built-in corpus. Unlike `oflm bench`, max_batch and iterations here fall back to the CLI flags when absent from the file.
